summary:
Reused #456 without recertifying its model from scratch and #462 alternating-effects controls. Added an activated-response Ontic adapter, a separately stipulated world-invariant directed marker, and three exact omitted implication tests. A local manifestation rule yields necessary activity given necessary capacity; the rule is an open philosophical commitment. Necessary activity alone leaves a contingent effect and a nonnecessary true proposition. Intrinsic-power realist objection, rejected marker-as-full-power identification, and source-attribution boundary are preserved in docs/bearer-capacity-exercise.md. No source search or attribution was performed; no root premises changed.

Curation pass 2, lane D batch 3 (#2103, 2026-11-27). da80929e remains unplaced. The response ontology retains the same necessarily existing bearer and the supplied directed response at both worlds. Its causal edge to true occurs only at world true. This separates intervention-response capacity from actual exercise at each world and from exercise at every accessible world, using the off-path response-to-production conditions.
